name: upstream-add-session-numbering
title: Trellis add_session.py assigns a session number from the working tree alone, so concurrent branches collide
description: Trellis add_session.py derives the next session number by reading Total Sessions out of the working tree's index.md and adding one, consulting no Git ref. Every branch cut from the same base therefore claims the same number; on 2026-08-06 three branches each claimed Session 308, and each merge after the first conflicted in journal-7.md and index.md and needed a hand renumber. Two further defects in the same script surfaced the same day: generate_session_content emits its own Main Changes and Testing headings while no CLI flag sets testing content, so a caller with validation evidence must embed headings in --content-file and ends up with a duplicate empty heading (final-bundle: journal_content_missing); and the commit table accepts any comma-separated hash without checking reachability or parent count, so a merge commit produces planning_recovery_commit_non_linear. .trellis/scripts has zero manifest.json entries, so the script is vendored Trellis and its correction belongs upstream, while the pack-local detection belongs in review-preflight.mjs, which already owns the journal rules that caught both failures.
creator: sdelmas
